39600.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of paccha

examples.text: mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha
yo ca pubbe pamajjitvā, pacchā so nappamajjati, so'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā mutto'va candimā.

39601.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of paccha

examples.text: yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure, yathā adho tathā uddhaṃ, yathā uddhaṃ tathā adho.
so tayā evaṃ ovadīyamāno evaṃ anusāsīyamāno ummaggaṃ gahetvā pacchāmukho gaccheyya.

39602.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, abl sg of paccha

examples.text: brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchābhūmakā kamaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā aggiparicārikā udak'orohakā soceyyāni paññapenti, tes'āhaṃ soceyyāni rocemī'ti
brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchā bhūmakā kāmaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā udak'orohakā aggiparicārakā. te mataṃ kālaṅ'kataṃ uyyāpenti nāma saññāpenti nāma saggaṃ nāma okkāmenti.

39603.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, abl sg of paccha

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā pacchā laṅghati, kubbaraṃ hanati, tidaṇḍaṃ bhañjati. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo assadoso.

39604.commentary: (ADha) pacchājātā'ti yassa kāyassa paccayā honti, tasmiṃ uppajjitvā ṭhite jātā.

examples.text: ubho'pi panthe jātattā panthakā nāma jātā. tesaṃ paṭhamajāto mahāpanthako nāma, pacchājāto cūḷapanthako nāma.

39605.commentary: (SNa) pacch'ātape'ti pāsādacchāyāya puratthimadisaṃ paṭicchannattā pāsādassa pacchimadisābhāge ātapo hoti, tasmiṃ ṭhāne paññattavarabuddh'āsane nisinno'ti attho.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā sāy'anhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito pacch'ātape nisinno hoti piṭṭhiṃ otāpayamāno.

39608.meaning1: sloping to the west; slanting westwards

examples.text: gaṅgā, bhante, nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā. sā na sukarā pacchāninnaṃ kātuṃ pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāraṃ.

39609.meaning1: going to bed after; (comm) sitting down after
39609.commentary: (SNa) tassa āsanaṃ datvā tasmiṃ nisinne pacchā nipatati nisīdatī'ti, pacchānipātī.

examples.text: so taṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ taṃ, bhante'ti. tam'enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upaṭṭhāpeyya. so upaṭṭhaheyya pubb'uṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī.
sakyarūpaṃ pure santaṃ, mayā sippaṃ na sikkhitaṃ, kicchā vutti asippassa, iti pacch'ānutappati.

39613.meaning1: having remorse later; regretting it afterwards
39613.commentary: (SNa) m'āhu pacch'ānutāpinī… pacchā vippaṭisārinī mā ahosī'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: n'atthi nissaraṇaṃ loke, kiṃ vivekena kāhasi, bhuñjāhi kāmaratiyo, m'āhu pacch'ānutāpinī.

39614.meaning1: sloping to the west; slanting westwards

examples.text: gaṅgā, bhante, nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā. sā na sukarā pacchāninnaṃ kātuṃ pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāraṃ.

39615.meaningLit: after and before; in front and behind

examples.text: atha pacchāpure asaṃkhittaṃ vimuttaṃ appaṇihitan'ti pajānāti

39616.meaning1: continuous awareness; perception of before and after
39616.meaningLit: awareness of what is in front and behind

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pacchāpuresaññī ca viharati, yathā pure tathā pacchā, yathā pacchā tathā pure? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pacchāpuresaññā suggahitā hoti sumanasikatā sūpadhāritā suppaṭividdhā paññāya.

39617.meaningLit: aware of what is in front and behind
39617.commentary: (ANa) pacchāpuresaññī'ti purato ca pacchato ca abhiharaṇasaññāya saññāvā.

examples.text: no ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha tato tvaṃ, moggallāna, pacchāpuresaññī caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhaheyyāsi antogatehi indriyehi abahigatena mānasena

39618.meaning1: sloping to the west; inclining westwards

examples.text: gaṅgā, bhante, nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā. sā na sukarā pacchāninnaṃ kātuṃ pacchāpoṇaṃ pacchāpabbhāraṃ.

39619.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of pacchābāha
39619.meaning1: with hands tied behind one's back
39619.meaning2: with hands tied behind one's back

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya pār'atthiko pāragavesī pāragāmī pāraṃ taritu'kāmo. so orime tīre daḷhāya anduyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ baddho.
gacchatha, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhaṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā

39620.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of pacchābāhu
39620.meaning1: with hands tied behind one's back

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, rājā khattiyo muddh'ābhisitto purise āṇāpesi, tena hi, bhaṇe, imaṃ purisaṃ daḷhāya rajjuyā pacchābāhuṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ bandhitvā khuramuṇḍaṃ karitvā kharassarena paṇavena rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ parinetvā dakkhiṇena dvārena nikkhamitvā dakkhiṇato nagarassa sunisedhaṃ nisedhetha, mūlaghaccaṃ karotha, sīsam'assa chindathā'ti.

39621.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of pacchābhatta
39621.meaning1: after eating; after the meal; in the late morning
39621.commentary: (VIN 2.5.5.6) pacchābhattaṃ nāma yena nimantito taṃ antamaso kus'aggena'pi bhuttaṃ hoti. (ANa) pacchābhattan'ti bhattassa pacchato.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu nimantito sabhatto samāno santaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā purebhattaṃ vā pacchābhattaṃ vā kulesu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya aññatra samayā, pācittiyaṃ.

tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.

39622.meaning2: who, while eating food given only before noon, refuses any extra food after he has accepted his meal; after-food refuser (a practiser of one of the 13 dhutaṅga)

39624.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of pacchābhāga

examples.text: [… ṭīkāyaṃ ca pāḷiyaṃ rāmass'eva samāpattilābhitā āgatā na udakassā'ti ādi pacchābhāge pakāsitā]
evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yaṃ taṃ tejaṃ viriyaṃ nippharati, taṃ pacch'ābhinibbattaṃ, n'āhaṃ tattha kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi, yadidaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttin'ti.

39626.meaning1: facing towards the west; orientated in a westerly direction
39626.meaning2: facing towards the west; orientated in a westerly direction

examples.text: puratthimāya disāya dhataraṭṭho mahārājā pacch'ābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā, dakkhiṇāya disāya virūḷhako mahārājā uttar'ābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā
ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ, icchāma mayaṃ, bhante, pacchābhūmaṃ janapadaṃ gantuṃ, pacchābhūme janapade nivāsaṃ kappetun'ti.

39628.meaning1: from the western land; living in the west

examples.text: brāhmaṇā, bhante, pacchābhūmakā kamaṇḍalukā sevālamālikā aggiparicārikā udak'orohakā soceyyāni paññapenti, tes'āhaṃ soceyyāni rocemī'ti.

39629.meaning1: travelling to the western land; headed west

examples.text: atha kho sambahulā pacchābhūmagamikā bhikkhū yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.

39630.commentary: (THa) passantu taṃ sākiyā koḷiyā ca, pacchāmukhaṃ rohiniyaṃ tarantan'ti rohinī nāma nadī sākiyakoḷiyajanapadānaṃ antare uttaradisato dakkhiṇamukhā sandati, rājagahaṃ c'assā puratthimadakkhiṇāya disāya, tasmā rājagahato kapilavatthuṃ gantuṃ taṃ nadiṃ tarantā pacchāmukhā hutvā taranti. ten'āha passantu taṃ… tarantan'ti. bhagavantaṃ pacchāmukhaṃ rohiniṃ nāma nadiṃ atikkamantaṃ sākiyakoḷiyajanapadavāsino passantū'ti kapilavatthugamanāya bhagavantaṃ āyācanto ussāheti.

examples.text: so tayā evaṃ ovadīyamāno evaṃ anusāsīyamāno ummaggaṃ gahetvā pacchāmukho gaccheyya.
n'ev'ātisītaṃ na pan'ātiuṇhaṃ, sukhā utu addhaniyā bhadante, passantu taṃ sākiyā koḷiyā ca, pacchāmukhaṃ rohiniyaṃ tarantaṃ.

39631.meaning1: shaded place; shady area; dense shade
39631.meaning2: shaded part, place in the shade
39631.commentary: (PYt) pacchāyāyan'ti ettha pakāro paccant'atthavācako'ti āha vihārapaccante chāyāyan'ti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā gilānā vuṭṭhito aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā vihārā nikkhamitvā vihārapacchāyāyaṃ paññatte āsane nisīdi.

39632.commentary: (ANa) pacch'āliyaṃ khipantī'ti pacchato gantvā piṭṭhiṃ pādena paharanti.

examples.text: ime, bhante, licchavikumārakā caṇḍā pharusā apānubhā. yāni'pi tāni kulesu paheṇakāni pahīyanti, ucchū'ti vā badarā'ti vā pūvā'ti vā modakā'ti vā saṃkulikā'ti vā, tāni vilumpitvā vilumpitvā khādanti, kul'itthīnam'pi kulakumārīnam'pi pacch'āliyaṃ khipanti.

39633.meaning2: gives blow on back; (comm) comes up behind and strikes on the back with foot
39633.commentary: (ANa) pacch'āliyaṃ khipantī'ti pacchato gantvā piṭṭhiṃ pādena paharanti.

examples.text: ime, bhante, licchavikumārakā caṇḍā pharusā apajahā… kul'itthīnam'pi kulakumārīnam'pi pacch'āliyaṃ khipan'ti.

39634.meaning1: monk who walks behind; accompanying monk
39634.meaning2: junior monk who walks behind a senior on his rounds

examples.text: atha kho, pāpima, kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya āyasmatā vidhurena pacchāsamaṇena gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
atha kho bhagavā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya āyasmatā ānandena pacchāsamaṇena yena aññataraṃ kulaṃ ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.

39635.meaningLit: discourse on the monk who walks behind

examples.text: sārattā kāmabhogesu, giddhā kāmesu mucchitā, atisāraṃ na bujjhanti, migā kūṭaṃ'va oḍḍitaṃ, pacchā'saṃ kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hi'ssa pāpako'ti.

39637.meaning1: afterwards for him; later for him

examples.text: atha pāpāni kammāni, karaṃ bālo na bujjhati, pacch'āssa kaṭukaṃ hoti, vipāko hi'ssa pāpako'ti.

39638.meaning1: what should have been said later; what should have been stated afterwards

examples.text: micchāpaṭipanno tvam'asi, aham'asmi sammāpaṭipanno. sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. purevacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca, pacchāvacanīyaṃ pure avaca. adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. āropito te vādo, cara vādappamokkhāya. niggahito'si, nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī'ti.

39639.meaning1: who has remorse afterwards; who has regret later

examples.text: etāni, cunda, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññ'āgārāni, jhāyatha, cunda, mā pamād'attha, mā pacchāvippaṭisārino ahuvattha, ayaṃ kho amhākaṃ anusāsanī'ti.

so yāva bhattaṃ otarati, tāva sandhāretuṃ asakkonto uḷuṅkena kañjikaṃ harāpetvā yathāladdhena byañjanena saddhiṃ allam'eva bhattaṃ pacchiyaṃ opīḷetvā ādāya yojanikaṃ maggaṃ pakkanto, tassa gacchantass'eva bhattaṃ pakkaṃ ahosi

39645.meaning2: cuts short, breaks up, puts an end to

39646.meaning1: cutting short; cutting off; interrupting; abruptly ending

39647.meaning2: cut short, broke up, put an end to

39648.meaning2: having cut short, having broken up, having put an end to

39650.meaning2: cut short, broken up, put an end to

39651.commentary: (THa) kiñ'c'āpi pacchimo kālo'ti yadip'āyaṃ atītasatthuko carimo kālo, tathā'pi yathādhammam'eva paṭipajjanto vipassanaṃ ussukkāpento

examples.text: saritvā pubbake yogī, tesaṃ vattam'anussaraṃ, kiñ'c'āpi pacchimo kālo, phuseyya amataṃ padaṃ.

39652.meaning1: what was said after; what was stated subsequently
39652.commentary: (MNa) purimena vā pacchiman'ti kāyadaṇḍo mahanto'ti iminā purimena vacanena idāni manodaṇḍo mahanto'ti idaṃ vacanaṃ. pacchimena vā puriman'ti tena vā pacchimena aduṃ purimavacanaṃ na ghaṭiyati.

examples.text: manasi karohi, gahapati, manasi karitvā kho, gahapati, byākarohi. na kho te sandhiyati purimena vā pacchimaṃ, pacchimena vā purimaṃ.

39653.notes: When facing east, west is behind one.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo padavītihāro ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma puratthimā samuddā pacchimo samuddo.

tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ambho purisa, yassa tvaṃ pāsādassa ārohaṇāya nisseṇiṃ karosi, jānāsi taṃ pāsādaṃ puratthimāya vā disāya dakkhiṇāya vā disāya pacchimāya vā disāya uttarāya vā disāya ucco vā nīco vā majjhimo vā'ti?
sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya.
seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti
cīvaraṃ nāma channaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ, vikappan'upagaṃ pacchimaṃ.

anīkaṃ nāma hatth'ānīkaṃ, ass'ānīkaṃ, rath'ānīkaṃ, patt'ānīkaṃ. tayo hatthī pacchimaṃ hatth'ānīkaṃ, tayo assā pacchimaṃ ass'ānīkaṃ, tayo rathā pacchimaṃ rath'ānīkaṃ, cattāro purisā sarahatthā pattī pacchimaṃ patt'ānīkaṃ.
dv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamāno araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevāmi. katame dve? attano ca diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraṃ sampassamāno, pacchimañ'ca janataṃ anukampamāno.

nimi tesaṃ rājā pacchimako ahosi dhammiko dhammarājā dhamme ṭhito mahārājā, dhammaṃ carati brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamesu c'eva jānapadesu ca, uposathañ'ca upavasati cātuddasiṃ pañcadasiṃ aṭṭhamiñ'ca pakkhassa.

39658.commentary: (DNa) yo pacchimako'ti yo guṇavasena pacchimako. ānandattheraṃ'y'eva sandhāy'āha.

examples.text: imesañ'hi, ānanda, pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ yo pacchimako bhikkhu, so sot'āpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo'ti.

39659.commentary: (ANa) vass'ūpanāyikā'ti vass'ūpagamanāni. purimikā'ti apar'ajjugatāya āsāḷhiyā upagantabbā purimakattikapuṇṇamipariyosānā paṭhamā temāsī. pacchimikā'ti māsagatāya āsāḷhiyā upagantabbā pacchimakattikapariyosānā pacchimā temāsī'ti.

examples.text: katamā dve? purimikā ca pacchimikā ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve vass'ūpanāyikā'ti.

39660.meaning1: later talk; what was said afterwards

39661.meaning1: (of an animal) back of the body; hind-part

examples.text: so āneñjaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāriyamāno n'eva purime pāde copeti na pacchime pāde copeti, na purimakāyaṃ copeti na pacchimakāyaṃ copeti, na sīsaṃ copeti, na kaṇṇe copeti, na dante copeti, na naṅguṭṭhaṃ copeti, na soṇḍaṃ copeti.

39662.commentary: (VAt) ekaratanamattā suviññeyyatarā hotī'ti katvā vuttaṃ pacchimakoṭiyā hatthamattā sīmantarikā ṭhapetabbā'ti. ek'aṅgulimattā'pi sīmantarikā vaṭṭati'y'eva. tattakena'pi hi sīmā asambhinnāva hoti.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati? yañ'ca, bhikkhave, tassa dīpassa purim'ante udakaṃ, yañ'ca pacchim'ante udakaṃ, ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma tassā nadiyā eko soto tv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.
taḷākaṃ vasupūritaṃ ghammapathe, tividh'aggipiḷesita-nibbāpanaṃ, byādhi-panudana-osadhayo, pacchimasuttapavarā ṭhapitā.

39666.commentary: (MNa) pacchimasopānakaḷevarā'ti yāva paṭhamasopānaphalakā ekadivasen'eva sattabhūmiko pāsādo na sakkā kātuṃ

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, imassa migāramātupāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ, yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā.

39667.meaning1: later way of talking; subsequent mode of communication; later verbal dealings
39667.commentary: (ANa) purimavohārā pacchimavohāran'ti purimakathāya pacchimakathaṃ, purimakathāya ca pacchimakathā, pacchimakathāya ca purimakathā na sametī'ti attho.

examples.text: vokkamati ayam'āyasmā purimavohārā pacchimavohāraṃ, aparisuddhavohāro ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā parisuddhavohāro'ti.

39668.meaning1: later generation; people in the future

39669.meaning1: facing towards the west; orientated in a westerly direction

examples.text: kāpilavatthavā'pi kho sakyā pāde pakkhāletvā santh'āgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchim'ābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva purakkhatvā.
tāsaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ bhikkhunisatānaṃ yā pacchimitā bhikkhunī sā sot'āpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanāti.

39672.meaning2: last moment, time of dying; final time

examples.text: tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī n'eva kām'atthā na dav'atthā na rat'atthā, paj'atthā'va brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.

39678.commentary: (NIDD1) pajappatī'ti sīlaṃ vā jappati, vataṃ vā jappati, sīlabbataṃ vā jappati pajappati abhijappatī'ti, pajappati. (SNPa) pajappatī ca vippalapati

examples.text: anāgatappajappāya, atītass'ānusocanā, etena bālā sussanti, naḷo'va harito luto'ti.

39682.commentary: (SNa) pajappitā'ti taṇhā'va idam'pi mayhaṃ, idam'pi mayhan'ti pajappāpanavasena pajappitā nāmā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: yā kāci kaṅkhā abhinandanā vā, anekadhātūsu puthū sadāsitā, aññāṇamūlappabhavā pajappitā, sabbā mayā byantikatā samūlikā.

39683.meaning1: gives up; abandons; lets go (of); releases
39683.synonym: ujjahati, cajati, jahati, jahāti, nirassajati, paṭinissajati, paṭinissajjati, pariccajati, muñcati, vipamuñcati, vippajahati, virājayati, vissajjati, hati

examples.text: akusalaṃ, bhikkhave, pajahatha. sakkā, bhikkhave, akusalaṃ pajahituṃ. no c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa akusalaṃ pajahituṃ, n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, akusalaṃ, bhikkhave, pajahathā'ti.
bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ n'ādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.

39685.construction:
pa + jaha + ana + ka
pajahana + ka

39686.meaning1: for the sake of abandoning; to relinquish; to give up

examples.text: navame kilesānaṃ saṃvar'atthāya pavesanadvāraṃ pidahan'atthāya padhānaṃ saṃvarappadhānaṃ, pajahan'atthāya padhānaṃ pahānappadhānaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ brūhan'atthāya vaḍḍhan'atthāya padhānaṃ bhāvanāppadhānaṃ, tesaṃ'y'eva anurakkhaṇ'atthāya padhānaṃ anurakkhaṇāppadhānaṃ.
so abhijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, parijānanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, pajahanto ekaṃ dhammaṃ, sacchikaronto ekaṃ dhammaṃ sammāvimuttiṃ phusati.
katamā c'ānanda, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu ye loke upādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhān'ābhinives'ānusayā, te pajahanto viharati anupādiyanto. ayaṃ vuccat'ānanda, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.

39688.meaning1: gave up; left; abandoned; let go (of)
39688.synonym: avassaji, ujjahi, ossaji, caji, chaḍḍayi, jahi, pajahi, pājahi, vijahi

examples.text: aratiṃ pajahāsi sato, bhavāsi sataṃ taṃ sārayāmase, pātālarajo hi duttaro, mā taṃ kāmarajo avāhari.
ete ca vidvā manaso vitakke, ātāpiyo saṃvaratī satīmā, anugate manaso uppilāve, asesam'ete pajahāsi buddho'ti.

39689.meaning1: gave up; left; abandoned; let go (of)
39689.synonym: ujjahi, ossaji, caji, chaḍḍayi, pajahāsi, vijahi

examples.text: tesu ussukkajātesu, bhavasot'ānusārisu, ke'dha taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu, ke lokasmiṃ anussukā'ti.

ye ca kho keci, bhikkhave, atītam'addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ taṃ aniccato addakkhuṃ dukkhato addakkhuṃ anattato addakkhuṃ rogato addakkhuṃ bhayato addakkhuṃ, te taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu. ye taṇhaṃ pajahiṃsu te upadhiṃ pajahiṃsu.

39691.meaning1: to give up; to abandon; to let go (of)

examples.text: akusalaṃ, bhikkhave, pajahatha. sakkā, bhikkhave, akusalaṃ pajahituṃ. no c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, sakkā abhavissa akusalaṃ pajahituṃ, n'āhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, akusalaṃ, bhikkhave, pajahathā'ti.

39692.meaning1: having given up; having abandoned; having let go (of)
39692.meaning2: having given up, having renounced, having forsaken, having abandoned
39692.synonym: cajitvā, cajitvāna, nissajjitvā, pajahitvāna, pahatvāna, pahantvāna, vijahitvā, visajjetvā, vissajjetvā, vosajjitvā, vossajjitvā

examples.text: kiñ'ca n'eva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito? rūpaṃ… vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṃkhare… viññāṇaṃ n'eva pajahati na upādiyati pajahitvā ṭhito
brahmā'ti mātāpitaro, pubb'ācariyā'ti vuccare, āhuneyyā ca puttānaṃ, pajāya anukampakā.
putto ty'āhaṃ mahārāja, tvaṃ maṃ posa janādhipa, aññe'pi devo poseti, kiñ'ca devo sakaṃ pajan'ti.
ayaṃ vuccati, mahānāma, ariyasāvako visamagatāya pajāya samappatto viharati, sabyāpajjāya pajāya abyāpajjo viharati, dhammasotaṃ samāpanno sīl'ānussatiṃ bhāveti.
phandamānaṃ pajaṃ disvā, macche app'odake yathā, aññam'aññehi byāruddhe, disvā maṃ bhayam'āvisi.
itthī malaṃ brahmacariyassa, etth'āyaṃ sajjate pajā, tapo ca brahmacariyañ'ca, taṃ sinānam'anodakaṃ.
ākāse'va padaṃ n'atthi, samaṇo n'atthi bāhire, papañc'ābhiratā pajā, nippapañcā tathāgatā.
appam'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, dhammassa hoti anudhammacārī, rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca pahāya mohaṃ, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, anupādiyāno idha vā huraṃ vā, sa bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
sahā'pi dukkhena jaheyya kāme, yogakkhemaṃ āyatiṃ patthayāno, sammappajāno suvimuttacitto, vimuttiyā phassaye tattha tattha, sa vedagū vūsitabrahmacariyo, lok'antagū pāragato'ti vuccatī'ti.

39698.grammar: prp, masc instr sg of pajānanta, trans (+acc)

examples.text: sabbaṃ lokaṃ abhiññāya, sambuddhena pajānatā, vivaṭaṃ amatadvāraṃ, khemaṃ nibbānapattiyā.
